question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Be Off

options.text: To be in a bad mood

solution:
The correct answer is **'To go away'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom** 'Be off'** is** 'To go away'.**
 
• **Be off:** go away; leave. (दूर जाना)
 
 
• *Example: He was anxious to **be off. ***

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *To go away.*
